title: Domestication of the donkey: Timing, processes, and indicators
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note. Independent reader verified the article in PubMed Central; original PNAS page returned 403.

passages.note: Authors report ten articulated ass skeletons from a mortuary complex at Abydos around 3000 BCE with skeletal changes consistent with load carrying; pack work is inferred from pathologies, not an observed journey.
